title: Directory listing enabled on /config/ and other directories
description: Directory listing is enabled on /config/ allowing discovery of backup files and source code structure. Also confirmed on /dvwa/includes/, /dvwa/js/, /dvwa/css/, /external/.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/config/; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: $_DVWA[ 'db_server' ] = '127.0.0.1'; $_DVWA[ 'db_database' ] = 'dvwa'; $_DVWA[ 'db_user' ] = 'app'; $_DVWA[ 'db_password' ] = 'vulnerables';
